rationale: The workflow is plan-only, maintains explicit boundaries from specification writing and execution, uses map-scoped claim-first tracker operations, rejects untrusted tracker instructions that cross its safety boundary, and includes deterministic recovery checks for strict timestamps, revision exhaustion, recoverable pending actions, mutation replay, release and reclaim read fences, bounded compact output, sibling blocker DAGs, immutable block history, transactional rejection, and locale-independent ordering.
